summary: Branch adds one regression-guard test (tests/unit/check-email-table-fix.test.js, 54 lines) that does not exist on main. The underlying bug fix (check-email routes querying wrong 'agents' table) was already shipped via PR #171 (2026-03-11). This branch is the designated 'lead branch' from previous sibling investigations — dev/581c75ac and dev/694e69a0 were both marked duplicate/superseded with explicit instruction to resolve ecb6ef9b first. The test file cleanly adds value with no merge conflicts expected.

evidence.commitSubject: test: regression guard — check-email routes must query real_estate_agents
evidence.commitMessage: Routes were querying .from('agents') (orchestration table, no email field), causing duplicate email checks to always return available. Fix was applied in daea6410; this adds a Jest regression guard to tests/unit/ to prevent reversion.
